durationSeconds.description: The duration, in seconds, of the role session. The value can range from 900 seconds (15 minutes) to 3600 seconds (1 hour).

policy.description: An IAM policy in JSON format.

roleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role that the caller is assuming.

serialNumber.description: The identification number of the MFA device that is associated with the user who is making the AssumeRole call.

tokenCode.description:
The value provided by the MFA device, if the trust policy of the role being assumed requires MFA
(that is, if the policy includes a condition that tests for MFA).

roleSessionName.description: An identifier for the assumed role session.

externalId.description:
A unique identifier that might be required when you assume a role in another account. Provided to allow access to
individuals who have acquired the externalId to assume the role, rather than everyone in the account.
